title: As High as the Sky
story: Bless the Lord, O My Soul
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A man named David sang a song
With all his heart, and free:
"I will remember every good
That He has done for me."

[Chorus]
His love is higher than the sky,
As high as high can be;
Heavenly Father holds my heart
And takes good care of me.

[Verse 2]
He gives us good things every day,
He mends the hurting part;
He lifts us when we're feeling sad
And warms a worried heart.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
And when we say we're sorry, He
Will carry it away,
As far as sunrise from the dusk —
As far as night from day.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
So close your eyes, my little one,
And rest your sleepy head;
His love is higher than the sky
And all around your bed.

[Chorus]
mood: Remembering music. A slow, rocking three under the voice, like someone counting good things off on their fingers and finding there are more than they thought. Hymn-like piano in plain, unhurried chords, with a faint organ warmth held underneath. Each verse reaches a little further out, as far as the sky, then folds back in, so the last verse is the quietest and closest thing in the song.
